notes.text: Module upgrade materials (Data Supplement Sticks and Instruments) aren't counted: they can't be farmed, and Module Data Blocks limit module upgrades anyway.
Module Data Blocks are valued based on red certificates, but red certificate purchases are limited, so they may be worth more if you're short on time.
Material vouchers are valued at the average of the most valuable materials they can buy, so cheap picks like Rocks and Kohl don't drag them down.
Kernel pulls aren't counted (don't roll on Kernel banners).
Training Invitation Letters and Skill Training Packs are valued at the average cost across every operator of their rarity.
6★ selector packs aren't valued, since it would be nearly impossible to do. They are by far the best purchase available (except the monthly card): get them if an operator you'd use is on offer.
Contents and names come from the CN server and EN prices are estimated. They're usually right, but aren't official until the packs go live on EN.
"One of three" packs are generally poor value: they cost only $4 less than the no-luck selector, so buy that first. Only buy one if you'd be happy with any of the three.
These pulls can only be used on that event's banner.
